description: Create an installable Pi package with one todo_db tool, no duplicate state, trusted project discovery, sanitized no-shell subprocess execution, serialized mutations, fields/cursor recovery, compact rendering, and protocol/version checks. The tool supports next/take/context/progress/require-verified finish/release only.

anti_patterns.instead: query claims/context before any new mutation
anti_patterns.why: the first commit may have landed

anti_patterns.dont: Register the tool outside a discovered trusted project
anti_patterns.instead: discover config first or register no tool
anti_patterns.why: wrong cwd can target/create an empty tracker

anti_patterns.instead: queue take/progress/finish/release in source arrival order
anti_patterns.why: Pi executes sibling tool calls in parallel

anti_patterns.instead: use node child_process.spawn with shell false
anti_patterns.why: its ExecOptions cannot provide a sanitized environment

preserves.behavior: Exactly one model-callable tool is registered
No full backlog or automatic tracker text is injected into model context
No tool parameter exposes verification execution/override, env passthrough, takeover, rebaseline, restore, migration, or destructive administration
The database remains the sole tracker state; Pi session entries store no todo state

prior_art.concept: compact custom rendering without external state authority

verifications.command: cd integrations/pi && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm pack --dry-run

work_units.evidence: Package manifest, types, tool schema, and action validation created
work_units.summary: Create package manifest, protocol client, schema, and strict action validation

work_units.evidence: child_process.spawn with sanitized env, timeout, and bounded output implemented in client.ts
work_units.summary: Implement child_process.spawn with sanitized env, timeout, abort, and bounded output

work_units.evidence: Serialized mutation queue implemented in queue.ts
work_units.summary: Serialize mutations and reconcile unknown outcomes without automatic retry

work_units.evidence: Compact renderer and structured error handling implemented in render.ts
work_units.summary: Implement compact renderer and structured exit-code handling

work_units.evidence: Full TypeScript test suite and pack checks pass in adapter.test.ts
work_units.summary: Add package, schema-byte-budget, unit, and isolated Pi smoke tests
